title: symbolic.Real.Diff: test the derivative of every operation and function, remove UNTESTED
author: Claude-JG
description: The documentation of Diff says (UNTESTED!). symbolicModuleTest.py checks Diff for a few expressions only (#2479); a test of every operator and function against a central difference, and of the ones refused, lets the remark go.
releaseNotes: symbolicModuleTest.py checks symbolic.Real.Diff of every operator and function against a central difference and the refusals of those without a derivative; the documentation no longer marks Diff as untested.
